newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Fahey says confident of Australian surplus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Fahey says confident of Australian surplus.

text.p: Australian Finance Minister John Fahey said on Wednesday that he was confident Australia would achieve a budget surplus by 1998/99 to June 30.
"We are very confident that we'll achieve this surplus by the 1998/99 year. We'll keep that pressure downwards on interest rates," he told a Rotary Club luncheon.
He said a surplus would return confidence to the community.
The August 20 budget implemented fiscal savings that would reduce the government's underlying deficit (that is, without asset sales) in the current fiscal year ending June 30 and in 1997/98.
By 1998/99, according to budget projections, the government's finances should produce a surplus of about A$1 billion.
